content_data.meeting_title: Cross-Disciplinary AI Ethics Framework Development - Working Group Session 3
agenda_items: Brainstorming session: identifying potential biases in large language models for aerospace design.
Planning next steps for stakeholder engagement and feedback collection.
Discussion on challenges of integrating explainable AI (XAI) into safety-critical applications.
Review of current draft principles for ethical AI deployment in aerospace systems.
key_decisions: Concluded that initial bias detection efforts will focus on data provenance and model training methodologies.
Decided to form a sub-group to investigate specific XAI integration methodologies for validation.
attendees: Dr. Lena Petrova (Research Fellow, Machine Learning Theory)
Dr. Kenji Tanaka (Senior Research Scientist, Autonomous Systems)
